        best_spot = s

delta = case["long_axis_yaw"] - candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=None)
rotate_by(delta)

lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
